# .github

GitHub Copilot adapters and CI for the agentic framework.

## agents/

Custom specialist agents for discovery, design, implementation, critics, validation, Git, security, traceability, multi-repo work, and business documentation.

## prompts/

Direct chat launchers for full workflows and individual stages/gates.

Examples:
- incremental-design-build
- bootstrap-repo
- system-design
- gate-a-review
- implementation-design
- gate-b-review
- local-validate
- clean-validate
- gate-c-review
- git-handoff

## instructions/

Path-scoped instructions for docs, tests, security, Python, Git, and agentic assets.

## copilot-instructions.md

Repository-wide Copilot adapter to the canonical AGENTS.md contract.

## workflows/

CI validates agent parity, canonical skill mirrors, eval fixtures, frontmatter parsing, and repository structure.
